title: Put your goods in
headline: Put your *goods* in
sub: A photo, a price, and every storage and colour in one product.

recap.en: Techline is open. Time to stock it.
recap.pcm: Shop don open. Make we stock am.

bridge.en: A customer messages on WhatsApp for a Nova X5. How does Ikenna take the order?
bridge.pcm: Customer message for WhatsApp for Nova X5. How Ikenna go take the order?

flow.action: Sets a plain unbranded phone on a small white display stand on the glass counter and photographs it with his phone, then checks the picture and grins
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Looks at his phone at the counter as a message arrives, reads it and looks up with raised brows
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

en: Ikenna puts the Nova X5 on sale.
He opens Products, then Add product.
He types the name, the category Phones, and the price.
Add product. The Nova X5 is in.
To sell it in sizes and colours, he opens it.
A second choice: Colour. Black, Blue, Gold.
Nine boxes, each with its own count.
Then he changes 128 gigabytes, Blue, to twelve.
Save. Nine sizes and colours, on sale.
pcm: Ikenna dey put the Nova X5 for sale.

Nine boxes, each get im own count.
Then he change 128 gigabytes, Blue, to twelve.
Save. Nine sizes and colours, ready to sell.
